cohort: 29,885 deliveries at Ordu University Medical Faculty Training and Research Hospital, Ordu, Turkey, from January 1, 2008 to December 31, 2020
finding: The Ten Group Classification System (TGCS) can identify trends in cesarean delivery rates and highlight groups requiring specific interventions.
mod_finding: The study found that the highest contributor to the overall cesarean delivery rate was Robson Group 5 (previous cesarean delivery).
